A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed visual odometry and 3D occupancy mapping method is efficient, accurate and robust for small-scale low-cost UAV navigation and environment reconstruction in cluttered environments.
the new system has the advantages of low cost, small size and high efficiency, and it is suitable for small-scale low-cost UAV applications.

the visual odometry algorithm is able to run at about 10 Hz on the ARM-based system and the 3D occupancy mapping algorithm is able to work at about 2 Hz on the onboard host computer with the pre-processed information from the new system, while the visual odometry is able to achieve 1.5cm accuracy for 6-DOFs pose estimation.

the proposed ARM-based pre-processing system can provide real-time visual information with high efficiency for UAV navigation and environment mapping.
